prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up shot of a hand holding a retro-futuristic handheld device, reminiscent of 1980s sci-fi technology. The device is boxy and rugged, constructed from worn, yellowish-brown metal with visible bolts, switches, and dials, evoking a sense of utilitarian, industrial design. The screen on the device displays the word "SERPUNK" in bold, white, pixelated text against a starry black background, suggesting a space or cyberpunk theme. The hand gripping the device is partially visible, with natural skin tones and a firm, purposeful grasp, emphasizing interaction and intent. The background is deep black, creating dramatic contrast and isolating the subject, while the lighting is focused and cinematic, casting subtle highlights and shadows that accentuate the textures of both the device and the hand. The overall style is gritty and tactile, with a shallow depth of field that blurs the background and draws attention to the intricate details of the device, evoking the atmosphere of a dystopian sci-fi film.
